paras: Iranolacerta zagrosica, also known commonly as the Zagros Mountains lacerta, is a species of lizard in the family Lacertidae. The species is endemic to Iran.
I. zagrosica occurs in the central Zagros Mountains in Esfahan and Lorestan Provinces, Iran.
The Zagros Mountains lacerta's habitat includes rocky outcrops and vertical walls in alpine meadows, at altitudes of 2,450–3,200 m (8,040–10,500 ft).
I. zagrosica co-occurs with I. brandtii, which prefers horizontal gravel substrates as opposed to rocky slopes.
I. zagrosica has a single postnasal plate, and ten ventral plate rows.
